segments.he: הַמַּעֲלֶה כְּזַיִת מִן הָעוֹלָה כּוּ׳. עוֹלָה וְאֵימוּרֶיהָ – אִין, שְׁלָמִים וְאֵימוּרֵיהֶן – לָא;
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «One who offers up outside» the courtyard «an olive-bulk» made up «of» the flesh of «a burnt offering» and of its sacrificial portions is liable. The Gemara infers: The mishna states that for an olive-bulk combined of the flesh of «a burnt offering and» of «its sacrificial portions, yes,» one is liable. By inference, for an olive-bulk combined of the meat of «a peace offering and» of «its sacrificial portions,» one is «not» liable, because its meat is eaten, not burned on the altar.
